source.note: GENRE-NEUTRAL SEED for a game with no registered pack (CommandSurfaceRedesign W1/D). `loombridge plan --genre <anything-unregistered>` seeds from this instead of exiting 2, and the build verifies as `genreCoverage: ungraded` with its gaps enumerated. The underscore prefix keeps this directory OUT of knownGenreIds(): it is a fallback template, never a selectable genre, so it can never be planned as a genre of its own or claim a coverage it has no oracle for. It deliberately claims as little as possible — every value here is a SCAFFOLD the developer is expected to replace, not a taste decision made on their behalf. It declares only the sections validateAcceptanceContract requires (game/fonts/palette/hud/framing/feel/juice/manifest/win) and marks every genre-shaped gate not_applicable, so a free-form build is never asked for platformer or shooter captures it cannot produce. It ships NO feel bands: an unregistered genre has no feel oracle, and inventing target numbers here would be exactly the fiction the coverage split exists to prevent.

global.note: Placeholder UI face — replace with the project's own. Chosen only because it resolves on every platform without an imported asset.

elements.role: Primary readout — replace with this game's actual HUD element(s)

playerAnchor.note: Deliberately loose. With no genre, nothing is known about how this game should frame its subject, so the band is wide enough not to assert a composition the developer never chose. Tighten it once the real framing is decided.

framing.note: 16:9 static frame — the least-committal rig that still lets the framing gate run. Replace cameraMode/anchor with the project's real framing.

hitStop.note: None declared. A generic seed has no impact model to freeze on.

win.note: PLACEHOLDER. Replace with this game's real win condition before claiming doneness — a build whose win rule is still `declared-by-project` has not decided what winning means.
